description: Check whether email addresses are deliverable. Always runs free local checks (syntax, MX, disposable domain, role address). With use_provider=true and a Hunter key, it also runs the Hunter verifier (1 credit each, cached). Returns a status (verified | likely | accept_all | unknown | invalid), a confidence, and the individual checks. Does not do SMTP probing or send anything.
name: sdr_verify_email
title: Verify email
